_comment: Representative Tier-3 inputs for Fretsplorer. Pitches are MIDI integers (the /core universal coordinate, see src/core/pitch-model.ts) as a MULTISET ordered low->high; octaves/doublings preserved (docs/03, R10). `key` is the home-chord-derived key context music21 needs for romanNumeralFromChord (Tier-1 supplies it, docs/01 D-Tier3).

cases.desc: Open G home chord, low-D drone: G/D, root tripled, doublings - the canonical Tier-3 sentence from docs/01
Open G barre 5 over open low-D drone: Cadd9/D, open D as the 9th (from open-g.yaml slideExamples)
Plain C major triad, root position - baseline I
C major first inversion C/E - figured-bass inversion check (I6)
G dominant 7th in C - functional V7
D minor 7th in C - ii7, a 7th chord with a non-root bass test
